Foxconn Debuts Humanoid Robots in Europe, Revealing Closed-Loop Physical AI Stack Foxconn humanoid robots made their European debut at VivaTech 2026 in Paris on June 17, as the world’s largest electronics manufacturer demonstrated a closed-loop physical AI stack — from Vera Rubin.

Foxconn opened its formal European debut at VivaTech 2026 on Wednesday, June 17, in Paris with a demonstration that reframes what the world's largest electronics manufacturer actually is: not a contract assembler of other companies' products, but a vertically integrated physical-AI platform capable of building the compute that trains the model, the robot body that the model inhabits, and the electric vehicles that share the floor.

At Booth 2B41 inside Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, a wheeled humanoid robot is performing precision assembly tasks in front of European industrial buyers — the first time Foxconn's industrial humanoids have appeared on the continent, and the clearest demonstration to date that the simulation-to-factory pipeline it has been developing with NVIDIA is no longer a roadmap item.

The debut also carried a hard manufacturing announcement: Foxconn, French computing firm Bull, and NVIDIA formalized a milestone under which components for the NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale AI supercomputer will be produced at Foxconn's facilities in the Czech Republic, then assembled and fully validated at Bull's factory in Angers, France.

The Vera Rubin systems will commercialize under the Bull brand — Europe's first domestically manufactured instance of NVIDIA's most advanced AI server architecture, and the first concrete output of a Bull-Foxconn partnership announced just sixteen days earlier.

key_excerpts.text: 理解大模型，无需再训练一个替代网络
至知研究院提出大模型可解释性新路线：拆权重，数据成本不到1% 思邈 2026-08-15 14:42:23 来源： 量子位 理解大模型，无需再训练一个替代网络 允中 发自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI 大模型机制可解释性研究中，一直存在一个颇具反差的现实： 为了理解一个已经训练好的模型，研究者往往需要先训练一套新的稀疏表示。
Transcoder、稀疏特征模块等方法会学习一组新的内部单元，用它们近似原模型某一层或某个模块的计算，再通过保留、移除这些单元来寻找任务回路。
这些方法推动了机制可解释性的发展，但也带来了一笔不小的额外成本：新的表示需要数据和优化，而且一旦替代模块没有充分复现原模块，后续分析就可能同时解释模型行为和替换误差。
说白了，研究者想打开一个黑箱，却往往需要先训练另一个“小黑箱”。
任务回路需要找到一组可以独立干预的内部计算：只保留它们时，相关能力仍然存在；移除它们时，模型表现则明显下降。
